headline: Ransomware Incident Shuts Down Hitachi Astemo's Dongguan Production Site
body: A recent ransomware attack has led to a shutdown at Hitachi Astemo Automotive Powertrain Technologies’ facility in Dongguan, previously known as Dongguan Keihin Engine Management System. The cyber assault targeted crucial manufacturing and logistics systems, halting operations. Experts are currently collaborating with the company to restore functionality, though the timeline for resuming full operations is yet unclear. Concurrently, NGK Ceramics Suzhou Co., Ltd. is experiencing associated process disturbances.
